title: The Geometry Is the Memory: Task-Density Routing for Continual LoRA
abstract: arXiv:2611.33487v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Freezing older adapters does not ensure that a continual learner will select and use them properly at inference time. When multiple adapters exist, routing among them and identifying the adapter whose representation space matches the query's answer can be difficult. We propose CONTLORA, which replaces stored examples with compact class statistics for adapter selection and classification. Gaussian class models in a frozen representation select LoRA adapters, while accumulated feature moments exactly recover a class-balanced ridge classifier for fixed training features. Trained without retaining images or feature vectors, CONTLORA reaches 88.55% accuracy on 20-task CIFAR-100 and 86.99% on CUB-200. Across three benchmarks in the matched component study, its mean final accuracy differs from an independently trained stored-feature counterpart by at most 0.07 percentage points. translated_title: 几何即记忆：面向持续学习LoRA的任务密度路由
translated_abstract: 冻结旧的适配器并不能确保持续学习器在推理时能够正确地选择和使用它们。当存在多个适配器时，在它们之间进行路由，并识别出其表示空间与查询答案相匹配的适配器可能十分困难。我们提出CONTLORA，用紧凑的类别统计量替代存储的样本，用于适配器选择和分类。在冻结表示空间中的高斯类别模型用于选择LoRA适配器，而累积的特征矩对于固定的训练特征能够精确恢复出一个类别平衡的岭分类器。在不保留任何图像或特征向量的情况下训练，CONTLORA在20任务CIFAR-100上达到88.55%的准确率，在CUB-200上达到86.99%。在匹配组件研究的三个基准测试中，其平均最终准确率与独立训练的存储特征对应方法相比差异至多仅0.07个百分点。消融实验表明，任务覆盖率的提升并不一定带来分类性能的提升。
tldr: CONTLORA利用冻结表示空间中的高斯类别模型实现任务密度路由来选择LoRA适配器，并通过累积特征矩精确恢复类别平衡岭分类器，在不保留任何图像或特征向量的情况下达到与存储样本方法几乎相同的持续学习性能。
